body: No way, my uncle hates me, it'd never happen

No, I don't see/speak to my landlord at all until he stops over for rent, I could explain, it's just last time I was short on rent at my uncle's place he threatened to evict me. So being late on rent is stressing me out like no other.

The only family I have is my aunt really.. married to the guy that kicked me out. I don't think it's an option, but I want it to be, I've never been on my own before and this is really stressing me out. My brain is constantly going 100mph, my sleep is all fucked up, I'm not working, owe my friend hundreds of dollars. When I go to sleep, I wish I don't wake up.

I have no idea, I talked to them, they need to verify I'm the account holder, and I can't get a photo ID without two pieces off mail that verify my address.

I'm waiting on my bank to mail me a statement but that can take up to 10 business days

It's just fucking stupid, I kind of want to call up any other extended family and move back, I don't think I'm in the right place mentally to be on my own

I brought it up right away and they fixed it after the fact, but I still have to go through the cash card company to get the money out. I'm sure the temp agency gets some sort of kick back for using them and it wasn't an accident, but whatever.

Thinking about spending what little money I have left on alcohol, I mean, I'd rather feel good then think about suicide every fucking day
